title: False positive: /reports/status builds SQL only from a hardcoded allowlist
evidence: demo-store-api/app/main.py:28 reads the user-controlled `status` parameter into `key`. But at :29 `key` is used only as a lookup key in REPORT_STATUSES (:8-12), and any unknown value falls back to the constant "OPEN". So the `status` value put into the query at :31 can only be one of "OPEN", "SHIPPED" or "REFUNDED", all hardcoded constants. User input never reaches the SQL string.
recommended_fix: No security fix is needed. As a defensive cleanup, switch to a parameterized query (WHERE status = ?) so the code stays safe if the allowlist changes later and the scanner stops flagging it.
